objective: Traverse a finite nested array structure into a fresh shallow leaf list.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: flat with Infinity is a current standard API.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Flattening nested collection data is a practical transformation.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Traversal units, identity and cycle/depth domains transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Finite bounded ordinary arrays make the foundation exercise assessable.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Freshness and leaf identity checks prevent modest data loss.

defects: The unqualified however-deep wording omitted finite depth and acyclic assumptions.
A six-level cutoff and JSON-cloned leaves passed old shallow fixtures.
The junior repeatedly flattened one level instead of following the intended all-level traversal.
rationale: Define a finite dense acyclic domain and count visited entries/nodes by occurrence, including repeated branches. New cases exceed six levels, preserve frozen repeated object/null/undefined leaves and require fresh empty results. Junior now uses one flat call with Infinity rather than rescanning intermediate arrays. A separately authored iterator-stack traversal passes correctness and remains unknown without an XP penalty if its structural cost cannot be resolved. No timing proof or arbitrary-depth engine guarantee is claimed.

objective: Find the first strict-equality match in ragged rows without changing data.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Array traversal, indexOf and strict equality remain current.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Locating data in grouped rows is a practical search.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Ragged dimensions, equality and early-return reasoning transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Explicit constant-cost equality and dense rows keep the task focused.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: First-match and source-preservation checks prevent modest search errors.

defects: The original brief did not name strict equality for NaN, signed zero or references.
Object.is, coercive equality and mutation after finding a position passed old cases.
Output coordinate freshness and frozen rows were not checked.
rationale: Specify strict matching and read-only ragged dense input. Add cross-type, NaN, zero-sign, reference-identity, frozen-row and coordinate-freshness checks. All three revealed variants already use strict semantics, including indexOf's NaN behavior. The linear worst-case model counts rows plus cells, not only nonempty cells. Early-exit guidance remains a reviewed algorithm choice; finite value checks do not prove absence of all unnecessary reads. Conservative estimates of nested/early-return code are not penalized.

objective: Follow a synchronous finite page chain once in link order and collect shallow item references.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Callback-driven traversal and bounded array append remain current.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Following pagination cursors is a practical collection pattern.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Link order, termination, empty pages and ownership transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: The explicitly synchronous lookup avoids conflating this exercise with fetch or promises.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Skipping empty pages or rewriting source items can lose real data.

defects: The API wording did not clarify that getPage is synchronous and chain inputs are valid/finite.
Reusing one page's array, JSON cloning and mutation after copying passed old fixtures.
Decreasing page numbers, frozen page data and shallow reference rules were untested.
rationale: Specify a finite acyclic positive-ID chain, exact once-per-link callback order and bounded item arrays that keep spread calls within a reasonable size. New cases traverse 1 to 7 to 3 through an empty middle page, preserve nested arrays/object identities in frozen pages, leave mutable page order unchanged and return fresh empty collections. The target counts pages plus entries and explicitly assumes constant-time lookup; it does not include real network latency. Existing revealed variants and an independent while traversal pass.
